lines.text: Many learners say: Yesterday we play soccer.
Watched! I watched a movie last night.

native.hook: 说了“昨天”，动词也要变过去式！
native.tip: 中文动词不变形，英语里说过去的事，动词要用过去式：played。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Yesterday we play soccer.”？😅 中文靠“昨天”这类时间词表示过去，动词本身不变；英语的动词却要变成过去式：“Yesterday we played soccer.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“Yesterday we played soccer.”免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Yesterday is in the past, so the verb must be past: played.
en.caption: Do you say “Yesterday we play soccer.”? 😅 Yesterday is in the past, so the verb must change too: “Yesterday we played soccer.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
